function.name: manage_missions
function.description: Create, list, update, delete, or run background automation tasks (missions) in the Mission Control system. Use this to schedule recurring work for the agent or define on-demand jobs. The 'history' operation retrieves past mission execution records with optional filters.

_todo.description: Session task list. '- [x] done' / '- [ ] pending', one per line. Update each call. Empty string if unused.

command.description: The task prompt that the agent will execute

cron_expr.description: Optional cron expression for scheduling (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9am)

from.description: Filter history from date (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', for history operation)

id.description: Mission ID (required for update/delete/run, optional filter for history)

limit.description: Number of history entries to return (default 10, for history operation)

locked.description: If true, the mission is locked and cannot be deleted until unlocked

result.description: Filter history by result: 'success' or 'error' (for history operation)

title.description: Name of the mission (required for add)

to.description: Filter history to date (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-12-31T23:59:59Z', for history operation)

trigger_type.description: Filter history by trigger type, e.g. 'manual', 'cron', 'webhook', 'email' (for history operation)

complete_items_too.description: When completing a todo, also mark all remaining checklist items as done

description.description: Description or details

id.description: Todo ID (required for get/update/delete/set_status/complete/item operations)

item_ids.description: Ordered checklist item IDs for reorder_items

items.description: Optional checklist items for add/update todo operations

description.description: Checklist item description

id.description: Checklist item ID for existing items

is_done.description: Whether the checklist item is completed

title.description: Checklist item title

title.description: Title of the todo item

Use 'spawn_specialist' to dispatch tasks to specialized experts (researcher, coder, designer, security, writer). Use 'list' for quick status. Use 'get_result' to wait briefly for completion and retrieve the result; a running co-agent is not failed just because no partial tokens are visible. Do not use 'stop' or 'stop_all' unless the user explicitly asked to cancel a co-agent.

_todo.description: Session task list. '- [x] done' / '- [ ] pending', one per line. Update each call. Empty string if unused.

co_agent_id.description: Co-agent ID (required for 'get_result' and 'stop'; stop requires an explicit user cancellation request)

context_hints.description: Optional keywords or topics for RAG context injection (for 'spawn' and 'spawn_specialist'). Keep them short and specific.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for the final result of 'spawn' and 'spawn_specialist'. Keep it compact; the co-agent must return only one JSON object or array matching this schema.. Provide as a JSON string.

priority.description: Optional queue priority: 1=low, 2=normal, 3=high. Higher priority queued co-agents start first.

specialist.description: Specialist role (required for 'spawn_specialist'). One of: researcher, coder, designer, security, writer

task.description: Task description for the co-agent to work on (required for 'spawn' and 'spawn_specialist')

function.name: file_editor
function.description: Precisely edit text files in agent_workspace/workdir or project-root-relative paths: replace exact strings, insert lines relative to anchors, append/prepend content, delete line ranges, or use hashline operations after filesystem read_file with include_hashes=true for stale-context validation. Hashline hashes are content-only (not line-number based), so you can perform multiple edits in the same file without re-reading — just adjust anchor_line for lines shifted by inserts/deletes above them. Never use for Virtual Desktop paths such as Apps/ or Widgets/; use virtual_desktop read_file/write_file/open_in_app instead.
